pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: `page` inserts `empty` into the HTML unescaped. It is safe today because the caller escapes `q`, but the escaping duty now sits in the caller, so a later caller could introduce injection.
findings.fix: Pass a plain-text message, or pass `q` and the mode, and escape inside the template.

lenses.note: The change matches the PR's words. The bug fix is small and has one natural design, so it did not need a spec.
No spec file in this change.

The three new tests cover a search with no matches, escaping of the search text, and an empty table. Each would fail on the old code or on a wrong fix. I could not run them here because the Cloudflare workers test runner may be unavailable; CI covers that.
The diff touches no docs, and I found no doc in the change that describes this message.
The logic is correct. The extra COUNT query runs only when a search finds nothing.
The search text is HTML-escaped in the new message, and a test covers it.
